items.title: OpenAI Plans to Buy Google's AI Chips as It Looks Beyond Nvidia: Report
items.summary: OpenAI, one of Nvidia's biggest customers, reportedly plans to buy Google's TPU chips. Neither company has confirmed the report, and the price and size of the order were not disclosed.
items.titleZh: OpenAI计划收购谷歌的AI芯片，因为它看起来超越了Nvidia：报告
items.summaryZh: 据报道，Nvidia最大的客户之一OpenAI计划购买谷歌的TPU芯片。两家公司均未证实该报道，订单的价格和规模也未披露。

items.title: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss

items.title: New 14-inch MacBook Pro M6 UAE price starts at AED 8,499: Full release details
items.summary: Apple has confirmed official United Arab Emirates retail pricing for the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6, starting at Dh8,499 for the 1TB base configuration, with pre-orders live today and customer deliveries arriving Friday, November 6.
items.titleZh: 新款14英寸MacBook Pro M6阿联酋版起价为8499迪拉姆：完整发布详情
items.summaryZh: 苹果公司已确认新款14英寸M6 MacBook Pro在阿拉伯联合酋长国的官方零售价，1TB基本配置的起价为8499迪拉姆，预购于今天开始，客户交付将于11月6日星期五到达。
